content_english: Accreditation and Voting shall commence at 8:30 am and close at 2:30 pm, provided that any voter already on the queue at 2:30 pm shall be accredited and allowed to cast their ballot.
content_plain: Voting starts at 8:30 am and ends at 2:30 pm. Anyone in line by 2:30 pm must be allowed to vote.

content_english: The Presiding Officer shall, after completing Form EC8A, sign and announce the scores of each political party, take a clear digital image of Form EC8A using the BVAS device, and transmit the scanned result electronically directly to the INEC Result Viewing Portal (IReV) and the Collation System server before departing the Polling Unit.
content_plain: After counting votes and filling Form EC8A, the Presiding Officer must take a photo of the form with the BVAS and send it directly online to the IReV portal before leaving the polling station.

content_english: The physical copy of Form EC8A alongside the BVAS device shall be conveyed in the custody of the Presiding Officer accompanied by security agents to the Registration Area Collation Centre.
content_plain: The physical result form and BVAS device must be brought under police/security escort directly to the Ward Collation Centre.
